name: 卢克·科科特克
name_full: 卢克·科科特克 Luke Kokotek
birth_place: 美国,田纳西州,汉密尔顿县,查塔努加
introduction: Luke Ellison Kokotek is an American actor with Czech roots. Born in Chattanooga, Tennessee to Mary Miles Harrelson, a teacher and an actress, he is the youngest of five children. Luke has 2 older sisters and 2 older brothers--all of whom are actors, as well.While Luke began acting when he was only three years old in plays that his sister wrote, he officially began his film career at the age of five, as a rural mountain boy, on the set of HBO's The Righteous Gemstones. This particular episode was directed by filmmaker David Gordon Green (Halloween, Halloween Kills, Halloween Ends), so Luke's foundation in film was grounded with direction from one of the most prolific filmmakers of this generation.Luke has since worked on numerous feature films and short films for networks such as BET+, Amazon, and HBO. Over the past couple of years, he has focused particularly on the horror genre, playing supportive roles alongside icons such as Lin Shaye (Insidious franchise) and "Chop-Top" Bill Moseley (Texas Chainsaw Massacre). He continues his forte in the upcoming psychological thriller As Perennial As The Grass, written and directed by his sister, Zoe Kokotek. Luke also plays the specialty role "Shortstop" on the limited HBO Max series, The Staircase, in which his older brother, Ryker, plays "Young Michael Peterson", the younger version of the lead, Colin Firth.Luke and Ryker recently filmed together again as cast brothers and the sons of comedian Rory Scovel in the Amazon comedy You're Cordially Invited starring Reese Witherspoon and Will Ferrell. And Luke is absolutely thrilled about his next iconic role, which is being kept under wraps until it premieres.Whenever he is not on set, Luke can be found beekeeping with his mom, racing his hoverboard, scooter, and bike at jet speeds, building intricate wooden towns across his home library's floor, and gaming with his siblings.
